fills.researcher_notes: The government order 816-r, version of 17 December 2025, lists the Almenevo gas branch and gas distribution station as a planned federal facility, with a design volume of 67 million cubic meters a year. That fits a proposed project. It does not give a construction date. A June 2026 regional report says gas has reached Almenevo, see the status review.

The only source for 38.93 km is a design PDF. Running it through fetch.py (curl, TLS impersonation, Chrome clearance) still returned HTTP 403, and the Wayback copy of March 2024 did not load either. The order 816-r gives no length. Nothing else was found.
The only source for 200 mm is the same design PDF, which fetch.py (all three routes) and Wayback could not read. Nothing else was found.
Neither existing ref names an owner for this branch. The order 816-r lists the facility without an owner and the regional news page covers talks with Gazprom in general. Owner Gazprom PJSC stays.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The government order 816-r of December 2025 still lists the branch as planned. A regional item of 6 June 2026 says gas has already reached Almenevo. It does not say by which pipeline, so it may mean this branch was built or that supply came another way. No dated source names the branch as built or stopped, so no dormancy year is staged. A check for Almenevo gas news from 2022 onward is owed.
